description: Overused through as a literal rendering of Korean 를 통해.

examples: The bandgap is affected by pressure by changing defects.

description: Dropped English subject or dummy it after a Korean topic drop.
examples: After annealing, was confirmed by XRD.

description: Over-nominalization that obscures the action in a clause.
examples: The improvement of crystallinity was achieved.

description: Article omission before singular count nouns.
examples: Film was deposited on glass substrate.

description: Plural and countability transfer, including plural mass nouns.
examples: Many informations and equipments were used.

description: Methods procedures use past tense and Results figure references use present tense.

examples: A film was deposited on the substrate.

description: Number agreement or mass/count noun form is inconsistent.
Tense does not match the role of the manuscript section.
examples: Methods: We measure the films at room temperature.

description: A field term is used with the wrong technical sense or form.
Claim strength exceeds the evidence or changes the scientific relation.
